They planted 20,000 dune-grass stalks across 20,000 square feet, while researchers studied how grass spacing, wind and waves affect dune recovery.

This opportunity comes after her remarkable journey in ODIs, where she achieved the milestone of one thousand runs in a record-breaking twenty-three innings.

title: ‘Gift from Venezuela’: Trump says oil deal will help refill US strategic reserve
description: US President Trump announced a deal to secure Venezuelan oil for the US reserve.  This oil will be used to refill the Strategic Petroleum Reserve.  The agreement involves developing untapped oil fields in Venezuela.  Significant investment is needed before Venezuelan production can increase.  The immediate impact on US fuel prices remains unclear.

title: Transporter found murdered in Lucknow; driver, aide detained
description: In a tragic incident, a transporter was discovered dead with two gunshot wounds after being reported missing. Authorities have detained his driver and an associate as part of the investigation. Preliminary findings indicate that a property dispute, valued at approximately eight crore rupees, may have been the motive behind this heinous act.

Russia bids Rs 50,000 crore for 5 more S-400 squadrons to boost India’s air defence
description: Russia has put forward a proposal for an additional five S-400 air defence squadrons, a move endorsed by India in March 2026 after Operation Sindoor. This acquisition will significantly enhance the air defence capabilities of India on multiple fronts. The delivery is anticipated to commence approximately three years post-signing, allowing for substantial protection against various aerial threats.

title: Days after mother's death, Faridabad man jumps in front of moving train; dies
description: In a heartbreaking incident in Faridabad, a 26-year-old man died after jumping in front of a train. The young man had been dealing with significant mental health challenges following the recent death of his mother from cancer. After a family celebration of Raksha Bandhan on Saturday, he departed home shortly after preparing a meal for his father, leading to a tragic discovery by the railway police the next day.

description: Deepti Sharma has officially marked her 150th T20I cap, placing her among the distinguished Indian cricketers like Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana. As the twelfth woman in the world to hit this remarkable milestone, Sharma continues to be an essential all-rounder for India, making significant contributions with both bat and ball. Furthermore, she showcases notable performance records in the Women's Asia Cup.

title: Ferry carrying nearly 270 capsizes off northern Cyprus; 7 dead, 24 missing
'Protest is last option, nobody enjoys it': CJP's Dipke backs Manoj Jarange Patil
description: CJP founder Abhijit Dipke has expressed his solidarity with Manoj Jarange Patil's ongoing protest advocating for Maratha reservation. He pointed out a growing distrust in the government's promises regarding education and job opportunities. Emphasizing that protests become necessary when dialogue fails, Dipke underscored the critical importance of providing quality education for children from the Maratha community. He intends to meet with Jarange Patil to extend his support for the demonstration.

title: Texas law opens door to cheaper manufactured homes as cities push back
description: Texas is now expanding access to affordable housing by allowing manufactured homes in designated residential zones. A new state law aims to eliminate local zoning obstacles that previously limited these options. Nevertheless, the law does not specify the extent of land required for placement, meaning the actual impact will largely depend on local zoning choices and infrastructure expenses.

title: NEET row: Youth Congress protests at Bengaluru BJP office, demands Shah's resignation
description: Karnataka Youth Congress workers were detained while protesting alleged NEET exam irregularities. Demonstrators gathered near the BJP office, raising slogans against the central government. Police detained the protesters who had assembled at the spot and released them later. The Youth Congress alleged police used a lathi-charge to disperse its members. The organization demanded the resignation of Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

title: 1,300 days, 36 innings, no 100: How Babar’s Test century drought became a long story
description: Babar Azam's quest for a Test century continues as he remains without a hundred since December 2022. Over the course of seventeen Tests and thirty-six innings, he has frequently come close with several fifties but has yet to convert those into three-figure scores. His challenges surged notably in 2024, despite a temporary revival in South Africa.

title: Imran Khan row: PCB warns Pak players against speaking about jailed former captain
description: The Pakistan Cricket Board has instructed its players to refrain from making public comments about Imran Khan's health amidst his ongoing imprisonment and health concerns that have drawn international interest. The board deems an interview with Khan's sons as politically motivated. Former cricketers Moin Khan and Javed Miandad have voiced their support for his medical needs, while international cricket captains have reached out to Pakistan's Prime Minister regarding his situation.

title: Rebuilt with India aid, flood-erased Nepal school seeks help to rebuild on higher ground
10 'Toy trains' cancelled on Kalka-Shimla heritage route after track left hanging
description: Ten trains on the Kalka-Shimla heritage line were cancelled after heavy rain damaged the track. Soil slippage between Koti and Gumman stations left a section of the track suspended. This disruption inconvenienced many passengers who had booked tickets in advance. Meanwhile, rainfall across Himachal Pradesh led to sixty-four road closures. The state has suffered significant losses and over one hundred deaths this monsoon.

title: UP man rapes GF, kills her after taking sexual stimulant drug at hotel on birthday
description: A 23-year-old man allegedly booked a hotel room and consumed a sexual stimulant drug. He then raped his 22-year-old girlfriend and murdered her when she resisted. The woman, a Dalit, was returning to her village for Raksha Bandhan. Police recovered the victim's mobile phone and stimulant tablets from the accused. An FIR was registered under murder and rape sections of the BNS.

title: India, Uzbekistan aim to take bilateral trade to $5 billion by 2030: MEA
US uranium output triples as nuclear fuel becomes a defence priority
description: United States uranium production more than tripled in 2025, reaching its highest level since 2017.  Domestic mines supplied only a small share of uranium required by the country's nuclear sector.  Most supplies continued to come from overseas, highlighting a significant dependence.  The United States has been trying to rebuild its domestic uranium enrichment capabilities.  Major investments aim to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and strengthen the nuclear fuel chain.

title: From strange worlds to rare planets: Nasa’s Roman Telescope begins its cosmic hunt
description: Nasa's new Roman Space Telescope has launched on a mission to explore distant planets.  This observatory will search for dark matter and dark energy across the universe.  It is expected to discover thousands of new planets and billions of galaxies.  The telescope's wide field of view surpasses Hubble's capabilities significantly.  Roman will build upon the discoveries of Webb and Hubble observatories.

title: 'Gud khaye, gulgule se parhez': Tejashwi targets BJP-RSS amid Manjhi-Paswan quota spat
Babar Azam fails again! Ex-Pakistan cricketer calls coaches ‘poison for the game’
description: Babar Azam's Test performance struggles escalated at Lord's, where he could only manage six runs. Former cricketer Mohammad Yousuf voiced strong criticism towards the coaching staff, labeling them as detrimental to player improvement. He argues that Pakistan's dismal overseas record, compounded by frequent leadership changes, amplifies the pressure, with the team having lost nine of its last ten away games.

title: 417 FC wickets, just 3 Tests: The forgotten story of Subhash Gupte’s brother Baloo
description: Baloo Gupte, a talented leg-spinner, had a short-lived international career, featuring in just three Tests for India after his brother Subhash was sidelined. Despite only capturing three wickets during this brief period, Baloo's prowess shone brightly in domestic cricket, where he amassed over 400 first-class wickets, showcasing a talent that unfortunately didn't lead to more extensive Test success.

title: Vivek On Postpartum Struggle: Actor says depression is real; links it to Divyanka’s recovery
description: Vivek Dahiya candidly addressed the often-overlooked challenges of postpartum depression, emphasizing the physical and hormonal shifts many mothers face. He highlighted the supportive journey of his wife, Divyanka Tripathi, as she embraced her evolving body post-childbirth. Together, they are navigating the ups and downs of parenthood, finding joy in the daily lessons and deepening their bond during this beautiful new chapter of their lives.

title: ‘Violation of HC order won't be tolerated’: Agnimitra Paul on FIR against Mamata
description: An FIR was filed against Mamata Banerjee for allegedly violating a court order.  The case stems from a Trinamool Chhatra Parishad program held on August 28.  Police allege the program exceeded permitted timings and caused disruptions.  Ministers criticized Banerjee for disrespecting constitutional institutions and the judiciary.  The investigation will examine the roles of all individuals involved.

title: Iran war creates two front defence dilemma for US against China and Russia
description: The ongoing conflict in the Middle East has severely depleted US missile and air-defense stockpiles, leaving global defense capabilities compromised. Taiwan's defense posture against China experiences added uncertainty due to these shortages. Additionally, limited air-defense interceptor supplies hinder support for Ukraine, suggesting a lengthy and challenging replenishment process for these advanced weapons that could undermine readiness for years to come.

title: Delhi tightens fire safety rules: What property owners, developers need to know
description: In an effort to bolster city safety, new fire safety regulations have been implemented for buildings in Delhi. These updated guidelines, part of the Unified Building Bye-Laws, encompass eighteen crucial categories, including provision for fire engine access and secured exits. Additionally, structures are now required to maintain emergency power and continuous monitoring systems, all in response to recent fire incidents that highlighted the need for stronger protections.

title: Bullion watch: What will shape gold, silver prices? Fed bets, US jobs data in focus
description: Throughout September, gold and silver prices are likely to remain under pressure. Critical influences on trading will stem from forthcoming US employment data releases. Traders should be alert to how central bank anticipations and persistent geopolitical tensions will steer market dynamics. Special attention will be given to non-farm payrolls and unemployment rates, as market players speculate on possible shifts in Federal Reserve policy.

title: Michael Dell shares a 'special note' for COO as he completes 39 years
description: Dell COO Jeff Clarke marked thirty-nine years with the technology company.  This milestone coincides with Dell's major 'One Dell Way' transformation initiative.  The company is consolidating multiple applications and systems into a single enterprise platform.  This comprehensive change aims to simplify processes and enhance data flow across departments.  The transformation is designed to prepare Dell for an AI-driven business environment.

title: 'Heart of Central Asia': PM sets roadmap, $5bn trade target with Uzbekistan - top quotes
Istanbul to host first committee meeting of Turkey-Saudi-Pak defence alliance
description: Top officials from Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan met in Istanbul for a defense accord. This meeting follows the recent signing of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. The pact aims to enhance defense capabilities and interoperability among the three nations. Discussions will focus on collective deterrence and regional security issues. The alliance remains open to expansion with potential new members joining.

title: Himachal identifies 67 vulnerable glacial lakes, early warning systems planned for 4
description: The state is monitoring the identified lakes through satellite imagery and other scientific data to detect changes that could increase the risk of glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs), while technical solutions are being explored to install sensors and transmit real-time information from locations where conventional communication networks are unavailable.

title: 11 Slams, No 25th Yet: Can Djokovic finally end his Grand Slam drought at US Open?
description: At the 2026 US Open, Novak Djokovic eyes his remarkable 25th Grand Slam victory. With eight major semi-finals or better since 2023, he remains a formidable contender. This time, he benefits from a favourable draw, as young rivals Alcaraz and Sinner hold the spotlight. With Sinner out and Alcaraz recovering from an injury, Djokovic finds this moment significant, especially at the age of 39, for his potential final triumph.

title: Kabul, Kashmir, Mumbai, Pahalgam: Hafiz Saeed’s deadly four-decade terror trail
description: India has formally charged Hafiz Muhammad Saeed, the founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba, in connection with a new case of terrorism. The Mumbai Police have initiated proceedings for a trial in absentia, highlighting the legacy of LeT across various phases. Originating from the Afghan jihad in the 1980s, the organization has transitioned from focusing on Kashmir insurgency to embracing a wider range of terror operations.

title: How to avoid rental disputes: Delhi Police plans awareness session for Northeast tenants
description: Delhi Police will host an awareness program next week for Northeast residents.  The event will focus on rental agreements and security deposit issues.  Tenants will learn about their rights and responsibilities regarding rent.  Police will widely circulate advisories with community leaders' help.  This initiative aims to prevent and resolve landlord-tenant disputes effectively.

title: Watch: Captain Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s brave DRS call gets East Zone crucial wicket
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, at just 15, stepped into captaincy for East Zone during the Duleep Trophy semifinal after regular captain Ishan Kishan had to withdraw due to injury. His decisive action to challenge a caught behind appeal was a testament to his poise and growing prowess as a leader. East Zone's bowlers effectively maintained pressure throughout the match's initial session.

title: Amid software fears, Anthropic CEO says: ‘We’re not here to destroy anyone’
description: Anthropic's CEO assures investors that AI will not dismantle enterprise software companies.  He views AI expansion as a positive, collaborative evolution for the technology sector.  Wall Street experienced sell-offs after an AI announcement, but software firms have recovered.  Salesforce reported strong growth and client retention, deepening its AI integration.  Concerns persist regarding data security and enterprise autonomy with AI providers.

title: ‘Identify your real enemy’: Khamenei urges Gulf rulers to unite, defend each other
description: Iran's Supreme Leader urged Gulf rulers to identify their real enemy and confront it. He also called for Muslim unity and mutual defense against external threats. The message comes amid ongoing war and significant economic pressure on Iran. Iranian President dismissed speculation about the leader's health, stating he is healthy. Diplomacy and defense remain Iran's complementary approach to national interests.

title: Karnataka IAS officer arrested in KPSC recruitment exam row
description: CID arrested IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar on Sunday to investigate his involvement as the Controller of Examinations at KPSC. Reports indicate he failed to assist the ongoing inquiry into recruitment discrepancies. The Enforcement Directorate had earlier searched KPSC offices related to money laundering, with Gangwar's prior absence contributing to confusion in the case.

title: 'Bill Gates wrong about robot tax': Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang disagrees with Bill Gates' robot tax proposal. Huang believes AI will create more jobs overall, not fewer. He suggests companies with increased productivity tend to hire more people. Huang sees a future of reindustrialization with demand for skilled labor. This new economic era will create many jobs across various sectors.

title: 7 bodies swept into Gandak river in UP's Maharajganj, Kushinagar amid Nepal floods
description: Seven unidentified bodies have been recovered from the Gandak river in Uttar Pradesh. Devastating floods in Nepal caused a sharp rise in the river's water flow. Officials are working to identify the deceased individuals found in the water. Bodies were discovered in Maharajganj and Kushinagar districts by villagers and SSB personnel. Efforts are ongoing to manage the situation and identify the recovered victims.

title: 'Frustrated' elderly father, friend kill schizophrenic son in Delhi
description: A father and his friend were arrested for allegedly killing his son in Kalindi Kunj. The 64-year-old father claimed his schizophrenic son had become aggressive and unmanageable. Investigators found the victim's body with head injuries and signs of strangulation. The accused lured the victim to an abandoned container before assaulting him. Police recovered the murder weapon and bloodstained clothing from the scene.
